name: 3can-runtimehook
description: Keep task intent and semantic review current across long Codex sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Keep intent and semantic review current
interface.longDescription: An offline semantic supervisor for Codex tasks. It restores Owner Intent at Git, plan, prompt, resume, and final boundaries, then requests review for goal drift, hardcoding, fallback, stale state, or unrequested behavior.
defaultPrompt: Use 3CAN RuntimeHook for this task with the lightest useful review intensity.
Run this long cross-module task with 3CAN RuntimeHook.
Turn off 3CAN RuntimeHook for the current worktree.
